description: Five heading anchors that no heading in the linked Markdown file has: a uniqueness suffix left over from a renamed duplicate heading (the one repair the graph can name exactly), an anchor nobody wrote, an anchor that lives in another file, a dead anchor inside the file itself, and an anchor in a file with no headings at all. A live anchor, an anchor whose case differs from GitHub's, the second copy of a duplicated heading, and a link to a missing file (md.links' finding) all stay unreported here.
